purpose: Master event + dialogue catalog for the Forge 1.20.1 villager speech system

summary.coverage_required: 417/417 event definitions must have a production detector/adapter before completion

edge_triggering: STATE_ENTER fires once on false→true, then remains silent while true.
PERCEPTION_ENTER fires once when a subject enters valid perception; it rearms only after the subject leaves/LOS is lost long enough.
OCCURRENCE requires a new action/event instance id.
STATE_ENTER_WITH_SPARSE_REPEAT may comment once on entry and then only after a long ambient cooldown while the condition remains true.
SPARSE_AMBIENT is the only mode allowed to speak repeatedly without a new transition.
perception: Game event is not villager knowledge.
Local events must be spatially filtered before dialogue resolution.
Use LOS only after cheap distance/same-dimension filtering.
Distant boss spawn/death is not directly known unless the event is explicitly WORLD scope.
Knowledge types: DIRECT_VISUAL, DIRECT_OR_HEARD, HEARD, MEMORY_OR_GOSSIP, WORLD_AWARENESS.
style: Energetic is allowed; personal insults are not.
Villagers may complain about an action, not attack the player's intelligence/personality.
Children are curious/playful, not vandals or bullies.
Use dry humor, awkward pauses, banter, mild cockiness, rare strange/freaky lines.
Do not make every line a joke; short plain reactions are necessary.
Russian must be authored naturally from semantic intent, not literal machine translation.
modpack: Do not assume the minecraft namespace.
Adapters may map Create/Cataclysm/other mod events into generic semantic events.
Unknown modded entity/item/block should fall back to tags/categories instead of producing no reaction.
validation: Build must fail if any event_id has no registered detector/adapter.
Build must fail if any reaction references an unknown event.
Debug output must show event, perception result, rejected candidates and reason, selected line.
